attributes.board_name: Texas Board of Physical Therapy Examiners (Executive Council of Physical Therapy and Occupational Therapy Examiners)

rules.accepted_credit_types: All activities must be approved through the Continuing Competence Approval Program (CCAP) run by the Texas Physical Therapy Association (TPTA) or offered by a TPTA-accredited provider, approved before the license renewal date (a course may be submitted after attending). Ethics/professional responsibility courses need a single-course approval number. 1 contact hour = 1 CCU. Other activities per 22 TAC §341.3: college courses (letter grade C or higher; pass/fail not accepted), Board-listed specialty examinations, residencies, engagement activities such as APTA/TPTA membership and board/committee service.
rules.audit_note: CCUs are recorded on the online Continuing Competence Activity Summary (with attestation questions) before renewal. Quarterly random audit of licensees renewed in the prior period; 30 days to submit documentation; keep original completion documents 4 years after the license expiration date.

topics.who: Texas Jurisprudence Assessment Module (TX JAM, FSBPT), passing score required at every renewal; worth 2 CCUs (approval no. 91014TX); replaces the former ethics/professional responsibility course requirement
HHSC-approved human trafficking prevention course at every renewal (minimum 1 contact hour to claim CCU credit)

rules.notes: Biennial renewal by the end of the birth month; CCUs must be completed within the 24 months before the license expiration date. The Board defines 1 CCU = 1 contact hour (some providers still use 1 CEU = 10 hours). §341.2 last amended effective November 1, 2025.
rules.rule_quote: (c) For each biennial renewal, physical therapists must complete a total of 30 continuing competence units (CCUs); physical therapist assistants must complete a total of 20 CCUs.
